entities.title: Native-first examples: java.time
entities.summary: One test class per java.time class, one @Nested class per method: each test does a task with java.time and compares the result with UTV.
entities.purpose: Shows what java.time does for the same scenarios as the UTV-first suite. Expected values come from UTV wherever the two agree; otherwise they are literals, and the Javadoc's 'Compared with:' sentence says what UTV does. Subpackages chrono/, temporal/ and zone/ mirror java.time's.
boundaries: java.time's zone operations read the JDK's tz database; the class comments say so.
Tests mirror production (AGENTS.md 1.9): each test class is named after the class it exercises, and verification.json names it.
